name: Comskip Commercial Segments
description: Detects commercials in DVR recordings with Comskip and exposes them as native Jellyfin MediaSegments.
overview: Detects commercials in DVR recordings (and, on demand, existing library files) with an external Comskip binary, and exposes the breaks as native Jellyfin Commercial media segments so the built-in skip UI handles them.

versions.changelog: Check a cut: its joins are marked on the timeline, with Join buttons. Delete original per cut recording and Delete all originals, with the space they take; originals left without their recording are deleted after a day (new setting, on by default). Kept originals now go after 7 days by default (Keep the original file as a backup is off for new installs; an existing setting is kept). Another program's .edl stays with the original after a cut. The editor's picture fits the window (or Small/Medium/Large/drag). Fixes: frames follow quick jumps; the start lands on the first frame.

Commercial segments dashboard (admins): list recordings with their breaks and fix them frame by frame (wheel/keys, keyframes, previous/next black, mark-in/out), with timeline hover and scrubbing, an overview of every keyframe and fast forward. Cut commercials out of a recording with a fast stream copy, in the background, with Undo; resume positions and program start follow the cut. New setting: Cut rounding.

Web overlay works behind a Base URL; Install web overlay button and status on the settings page (shows the one-time permission command when Jellyfin can't change index.html); the overlay is put back automatically after a jellyfin-web update when Jellyfin may write the file. Press Update web overlay or re-run Web/install-overlay.sh once.
Fix: Jellyfin could crash while Comskip ran (its output and error output were written into one buffer from two threads at once). Same fix for live scans and audio trims.

Install Comskip button (self-contained Comskip 0.83.001 for Linux x86-64/arm64, all features) and a clear "Comskip isn't installed" message; program start from remembered channel cards with Undo trim; recording edits limited to chosen users with confirmation; Remove commercials keeps them removed. Re-run Web/install-overlay.sh for the web features.

Skip commercials in recordings still in progress (web + TV forks), web commercial badges, "Watch from start" for programmes being recorded, use existing .edl files, AudioTrim writes MPEG-TS for .mpg, menu and live-scan fixes. Re-run Web/install-overlay.sh for the web features.
Version bump only, no code changes.
Initial public release.

name: Episode History
description: SageTV-style episode history for the DVR: remembers what was recorded and watched (even after deletion), marks guide entries (✓ watched, ● in library, ○ recorded before), and cancels series recordings of episodes already in the library.
overview: SageTV-style episode history for the DVR: remembers what was recorded and watched (even after deletion), marks guide entries (✓ watched, ● in library, ○ recorded before), and cancels series recordings of episodes already in the library.

versions.changelog: Search page List view: shorter rows, so more airings fit on screen.

Search page: an On TV Posters/List switch; List shows the next airings soonest first, grouped by day, with channel logos, Will record/New/Live marks and the same ⋮ menu as the posters. Recordings by show: one card per show. Recording now lists a re-record or resumed piece. Tidy up after deletes also covers archive libraries, emptied seasons and leftover .ts.properties/.ini/pictures. Trash lets API-key deletes through. A favourite's recording of an episode already in the library is cancelled.
First public release.

name: JellyDVR Guides
description: Guide sources for Jellyfin's Live TV: XMLTV guides (cleaned of what Jellyfin misreads, such as "Movie (2001) (2001)" titles and missing episode ids, if asked) and Schedules Direct lineups fetched once a day, each served as one guide for one Jellyfin guide provider limited to its tuners.
overview: Guide sources for Jellyfin's Live TV: XMLTV guides (cleaned of what Jellyfin misreads, such as "Movie (2001) (2001)" titles and missing episode ids, if asked) and Schedules Direct lineups fetched once a day, each served as one guide for one Jellyfin guide provider limited to its tuners.

versions.changelog: Schedules Direct: shows without episode numbers (news, talk, sports magazines) count as series, so Jellyfin offers Record series for them. New per-source setting, on by default; they get a stand-in episode 0.

Schedules Direct: the daily update runs at a time picked at random for each server (2:00 to 6:00, never on the hour) instead of 5:00 everywhere; Update now asks again at most every 15 minutes. Status lines on the settings page break properly again.

Renamed JellyDVR Guides (was XMLTV Guide Cleaner; settings carry over). Guide sources: each is an XMLTV guide (cleaning optional) or a Schedules Direct lineup fetched once a day, served at its own address, limited to its tuners' channels, with an optional Jellyfin guide provider created per tuner. Schedules Direct programme pictures are kept and re-checked every 14 days (setting).
First public release.

name: JellyDVR Space
description: Keeps the DVR recordings drive from filling up: when free space drops below a floor, moves recordings (with their commercial marks) to archive storage you list, or deletes them, in the order you choose. Starts in preview mode.
overview: Keeps the DVR recordings drive from filling up: when free space drops below a floor, moves recordings (with their commercial marks) to archive storage you list, or deletes them, in the order you choose. Starts in preview mode.

versions.changelog: Store in: choose the storage folders for a show (Series options) or for one recording (Recording options), in Jellyfin's web client and JDVR; sorting puts each recording in the first of its folders with room. Each storage folder has its own floor; the settings page is in numbered sections. Devices: Remove takes a TV off the list and signs it out. Recordings still being recorded, or whose pieces Episode History has yet to join, stay where they are; moved recordings no longer get planned a second time.
Keep at least … free is automatic by default: a tenth of the recordings drive, between 10 and 100 GB (0 in the setting); a saved number is kept.
First public release.

name: JellyDVR Schedule
description: SageTV-style recording priorities and conflict handling: ranks your series recordings, looks ahead for times when more recordings are scheduled than you have tuner inputs, and moves the lower-priority one to another airing of the same episode or skips it. Starts in preview mode.
overview: SageTV-style recording priorities and conflict handling: ranks your series recordings, looks ahead for times when more recordings are scheduled than you have tuner inputs, and moves the lower-priority one to another airing of the same episode or skips it. Starts in preview mode.

versions.changelog: Settings page: the Remove and ▲▼ buttons are readable again on Jellyfin 12.2.
First public release.

name: JellyDVR Live
description: SageTV-style live TV buffer: records the programme you're watching from the moment you tune in, so you can rewind past tune-in, switch devices, skip commercials, or keep it as a real recording. Unkept buffers are deleted automatically.
overview: SageTV-style live TV buffer: records the programme you're watching from the moment you tune in, so you can rewind past tune-in, switch devices, skip commercials, or keep it as a real recording. Unkept buffers are deleted automatically.
